Profitability is also solid (EBIT/operating income 806M and net income 445M on 8,634M revenue), though liquidity appears only adequate with current assets of 2,929M versus current liabilities of 2,248M (current ratio ~1.3). Overall, this supports a high investment-grade rating.

DECISION: AA-
